text:
This year Hindustan Unilever took full ownership of OZiva, USV bought a majority stake in Wellbeing Nutrition, and Unilever Ventures led Supply6's ₹48 crore round.

Large companies are betting big on Indian supplements. As a brand that launched three weeks ago, here is how we see it.

More Indians take supplements every year, and most still can't tell what's inside the jar. When we asked our 1,870 pre-bookers what got in the way, the answer we heard most was simple: in a busy life, nobody keeps up with ten supplements.

So we built SILT around two drink mixes, one for the morning and one for the night. Every dose is printed on the pack, with no melatonin, no added sugar and no maltodextrin. Each of our 19 ingredients has a lab report, with 293 checks so far and none failed.

Big companies are brilliant at distribution. A small brand can show its working, answer every message and change a formula when the evidence changes.

Three weeks in, 250 people have bought SILT and 10 have already reordered. We read every review.

Does consolidation make this category more trustworthy, or less? We would like to hear from people working in consumer health.

#preventivehealth #D2CIndia
